eligible_conditions: Women at normal risk for cervical or vaginal cancer (every 24 months)
Women at high risk of developing cervical or vaginal cancer (every 12 months)
Women of childbearing age who have had an abnormal Pap test during the past 3 years (every 12 months)
Sexually active women regardless of age
exclusions: Women who do not meet high-risk criteria and have had a normal Pap test within the past 24 months
Women who meet high-risk criteria but have had a normal Pap test within the past 12 months
